name: Featherweights
effect: Your 1- and 2-cost units gain 20% attack speed and 20% movement speed.
notes: Strong pick for reroll comps that keep cheap carries late.

name: Best Friends
effect: Units starting combat adjacent to exactly one ally gain 12% attack speed and 15 armor.
notes: Requires paired positioning — remember to split your board into duos.

name: Spoils of War
effect: Enemies you kill have a 20% chance to drop loot.
notes: Best taken on a strong early board that win-streaks stage 2.

name: Rich Get Richer
effect: Gain 12 gold. Your maximum interest is increased to 7.
notes: Econ engine for fast 8 comps; weak if you must roll early.

name: Level Up!
effect: Gain 2 free levels now. Buying XP grants +2 bonus XP.
notes: Accelerates 4-cost carry comps to level 8 a full stage early.

name: Trade Sector
effect: Gain a free shop refresh each round.
notes: Excellent for reroll comps hunting 3-star carries.

name: Jeweled Lotus
effect: Magic damage from abilities can critically strike. Your team gains 15% critical strike chance.
notes: Effectively a free Jeweled Gauntlet component for AP boards.

name: Titanic Force
effect: Your units with more than 1600 max health gain 3% of their max health as attack damage.
notes: Turns fat frontliners like Sett into secondary carries.

name: Golden Ticket
effect: Each shop refresh has a 40% chance to refund its cost.
notes: Roughly doubles your rolls over a game — premium for any reroll line.

name: Radiant Relics
effect: Gain a Radiant version of a craftable item of your choice.
notes: Take the Radiant carry item that matches your comp's main damage type.
